note: ~60 chained beats (~5s each = ~5 min) covering all 7 Sanctuary-of-Silchar scenes. English 'visual' lines are the render prompts; 'vo_hi' carries your exact Hindi narration split across beats; music-only beats have vo_hi: null. Same engine/quality/voices/modesty as shots_moment.json.

globals.actor1_young: Indian man, late 20s, short dark hair, light mustache and stubble, slender delicate build, intelligent vulnerable melancholic gaze; fully modestly clothed in simple formal shirt/trousers
globals.actor2_mature: same man at 47, white hair, soft neat white beard, gentle kind face, calm accepting eyes, quiet relief; modest simple clothing
globals.gunja: tall elegant charismatic Indian corporate woman, late 20s, strong expressive brows, thick wavy dark hair, warm dignified grace; ALWAYS fully modestly clothed (saree or salwar-kameez or modest formal western), invented fictional face, consistent across scenes
globals.tone_kunal: serious, solemn, sorrowful, reverent, silent, tense jaw, downcast or fixed gaze, NO smile
globals.tone_gunja: serious, warm, emotional, fearful, teary; at most a rare faint guarded almost-smile, lips barely curved, restrained
globals.negative: smiling, grinning, laughing, cheerful, happy expression, teeth showing, playful, celebratory, nudity, nude, skin exposure, cleavage, bare shoulders, bare midriff, revealing or short clothing, sensual, seductive, suggestive, vulgar, sexual or intimate contact, kissing
globals.style: cinematic realism, 35mm film grain, anamorphic lens flare, mood-driven shadows, deep psychological contrast
globals.tone_override: NOT a happy-ending film. Serious and restrained throughout. Scene 7 peace is conveyed by a relaxed face, closed eyes and a slow exhale — quiet acceptance, NOT a broad or happy smile.

beats.visual: Cinematic low-angle, a frail thin young boy stands isolated at the edge of a crowded blurred schoolyard, shoulders hunched, looking down at his own thin hands, other children out of focus behind him, overcast desaturated grey daylight.
beats.vo_hi: बचपन से कॉलेज के गलियारों तक, ये दुबला जिस्म सिर्फ एक मज़ाक था।

beats.visual: Slow push-in on the same boy's face, eyes lowered, flinching slightly as unheard taunts land; shallow focus, cold grey tone.
Transition dissolve: empty school corridor emptying of blurred figures, dust in a shaft of pale light, no one left.
A dark, empty college library; a slender young man (Actor 1) sits completely alone in deep shadow at a long table, staring down at his thin hands.
Close on his hands turning over slowly on the table, then his downcast face half in shadow, jaw tense, no expression of hope.
beats.vo_hi: लोगों के तानों को सच मानकर, मैंने खुद को कमतर कुबूल कर लिया था।

beats.visual: Wide shot: the lone figure dwarfed by tall dark bookshelves, a single window light far behind him, isolation emphasised.
Hold on his still silhouette; slow fade toward the next chapter, grain heavy.
Atmospheric tracking shot: the slender young man walks through heavy rain on a grey street, clutching a wet folder of certificates to his chest, drenched, exhausted.
beats.vo_hi: कॉलेज के बाद सात महीने का वो भयानक संघर्ष...

beats.visual: His face in the rain, water running down, eyes tired and fixed ahead, no self-pity, only fatigue.
A dark cramped bedroom, he sits on the floor by a laptop, its cold light on his face, staring blankly at a screen full of interview rejection emails.
beats.vo_hi: एक के बाद एक रिजेक्शन, नाकाम इंटरव्यू और टूटता हुआ हौसला।

beats.visual: Macro insert: the rejection words glowing on the laptop, reflected in his still eyes; ambient hum.
He lowers the laptop lid slowly; room falls dark; he sits motionless in the dark, drained.
beats.vo_hi: मैं पूरी तरह थक चुका था।

beats.visual: Wide of the small dark room, single figure small in frame; slow fade.
A bright modern Bangalore corporate interview room; the protagonist enters looking completely defeated, shoulders low, clutching his folder.
beats.vo_hi: जब एक दिन इंटरव्यू के कमरे में वो मुझे मिली।

beats.visual: Reverse: across a clean desk sits Gunja — a tall, remarkably elegant, dignified Indian woman in modest formal attire, reviewing his profile; first framing of them in one shot.
Close on Gunja's face as she reads: her eyes fill with sudden deep warmth and profound intellectual admiration — love at first sight, dignified, restrained.
beats.vo_hi: वो मेरी काया पर नहीं, मेरी शख्सियत और ज़हनियत पर फ़िदा हुई थी।

beats.visual: Close on the young man: he looks up, still guarded and solemn, not yet understanding the warmth directed at him.
Two-shot across the desk, a charged quiet moment of recognition between them; soft window light, SONG shift to Sarki Chunariya feeling.
beats.vo_hi: पहली ही नज़र में उसे मुझसे बेइंतहा मोहब्बत हो गई।

beats.visual: Later that day, the young man stepping out with his first offer letter in hand, expression stunned and quiet, not celebratory.
Gunja alone at her desk afterward, a faint guarded almost-smile barely curving her lips, hopeful, restrained.
Montage: the young man at his new office desk, working, glancing once toward where she sits, then away; SONG becomes Aaoge Jab Tum, tender.
beats.vo_hi: वो इतनी खूबसूरत, लंबी और गरिमामयी थी।

beats.visual: Gunja walking through the office with quiet grace, dignified and modest, others blurred; his POV, reverent.
His face watching from a distance, a flicker of wonder quickly hidden behind his usual solemn guard.
beats.vo_hi: वैसी औरत जिंदगी में मैंने कभी नहीं देखी थी।

beats.visual: Golden office light on empty chairs at dusk; the feeling of a beginning; slow dissolve.
Close-up on Gunja at a polished corporate desk during an appraisal review, her hands shaking slightly holding a pen, throat tightening.
beats.vo_hi: दफ़्तर की मीटिंग्स में उसकी आवाज़ कांपती थी।

beats.visual: Her eyes welling with unshed tears, a woman on the verge of an emotional outburst, holding it in with dignity.
beats.vo_hi: जैसे वो किसी भी पल रो पड़ेगी।

beats.visual: She looks across the room toward him, pleading silently; he is out of focus, unreachable.
beats.vo_hi: वो अंदर ही अंदर टूट रही थी, बिखर रही थी।

beats.visual: Quiet office hallway: Gunja pulls the protagonist's friends aside, expression full of frantic desperate worry, asking about him; modest, restrained.
beats.vo_hi: जब मैंने बातचीत बिल्कुल बंद कर दी...

beats.visual: Her hand on a colleague's arm, eyes searching, whispering a question about him; worry etched on her face.
beats.vo_hi: तो वो मेरे दोस्तों के चक्कर काटती, मेरे बारे में पूछती रही।

beats.visual: Cut to the protagonist, face frozen like stone, staring blankly at the floor, completely unresponsive.
beats.vo_hi: पर मेरी हीनभावना ने मेरे मुँह पर ताला लगा दिया था।

beats.visual: His hands still on his knees, knuckles tight; he does not look up; guilt held silently.
Gunja alone at a window at dusk, turning away to hide her tears from the office.
beats.vo_hi: मैंने उसे तड़पते देखा...

beats.visual: The protagonist watching her turned back from across the room, wanting to speak, unable to; SONG Mora Piya swells softly.
beats.vo_hi: पर कभी सॉरी नहीं कहा।

beats.visual: Empty meeting room after hours, two chairs apart, unspoken distance; slow dissolve.
A dimly lit doctor's consultation room; a frustrated doctor slams a stack of perfect test reports on the desk; the protagonist sits still opposite.
beats.vo_hi: डॉक्टर परेशान था, झुंझलाया हुआ था।

beats.visual: Close on the protagonist, eyes wide with a mix of sorrow and clarity, absorbing the doctor's frustration in silence.
beats.vo_hi: वो बोला—'तुम पूरी तरह फिट हो, फिर समस्या क्या है?'

beats.visual: The protagonist begins to answer quietly, gaze lowered, choosing words with difficulty.
beats.vo_hi: मैंने कहा—'ये औरत अलग है। मैं उनसे बेइंतहा मोहब्बत करता हूँ।'

beats.visual: Flash cut: Gunja in a graceful, fully modest traditional Indian outfit, subtly trying to catch his gaze, eyes pleading for connection.
beats.vo_hi: उनकी इंसानियत, उनकी अच्छाई ने मेरी रूह को छू लिया है।

beats.visual: Flash cut: Gunja in dignified modest formal wear, a faint hopeful guarded look toward him across a room.
beats.vo_hi: मैं उनकी इबादत करता हूँ।

beats.visual: The protagonist firmly closes his eyes and turns his face away in absolute agony — a silent act of sacred protection, refusing to look.
beats.vo_hi: और जिसकी मैं पूजा करता हूँ, उसके लिए कोई 'गंदा' ख्याल आ ही नहीं सकता।

beats.visual: Two-shot: she stands near, hopeful; he keeps his eyes shut and face turned, protecting his reverence; strictly modest, no contact.
beats.vo_hi: जब वो मेरे सामने आती थीं, मैं अपनी आँखें बंद कर लेता था।

beats.visual: Night: the protagonist lies awake, sleepless, staring at the ceiling, hands folded on his chest; SONG Nindarian, worshipful and aching.
beats.vo_hi: हीनभावना और उनके प्रति असीम आदर के टकराव ने मुझे अपाहिज बना दिया था।

beats.visual: Close on his open eyes in the dark, wet at the edges, refusing to let the longing become anything less than worship.
beats.vo_hi: मैं अपनी पवित्र देवी को अपनी नजरों में गिरा नहीं सकता था।

beats.visual: Imagined/remembered: Gunja alone, crying quietly where no one sees, dignified even in grief.
beats.vo_hi: मुझे नहीं पता वो अकेले में मेरी वजह से कितनी बार रोई होगी।

beats.visual: The protagonist sitting alone at the edge of his bed at dawn, head bowed, carrying the weight of what he could not say.
beats.vo_hi: मैंने उसे बहुत दर्द दिया।

beats.visual: Close on his face, eyes closing slowly in self-reproach; SONG holds; slow fade.
beats.vo_hi: अपने ही डर के पिंजरे में कैद होकर, मैं उससे एक बार माफी तक नहीं मांग सका।

beats.visual: Sterile Bangalore hospital corridor with flickering cold blue fluorescent lights; the protagonist walks slowly, hollow.
beats.vo_hi: इस मानसिक बोझ से घबराहट और पैनिक अटैक्स का अंतहीन चक्र शुरू हुआ।

beats.visual: Macro slow-motion: white prescription pill strips scattered on a dark wooden bedside table, cold light.
The protagonist sitting on the edge of a bed, breathing hard through a panic attack, hand at his chest.
beats.vo_hi: कि आखिरकार मेरा वजूद ढह गया।

beats.visual: He signs a resignation letter on a desk, hand steady with grim finality, face blank.
beats.vo_hi: हार मान ली मैंने।

beats.visual: He packs a heavy suitcase in a bare room, taking one last look at the empty space.
beats.vo_hi: इस्तीफा देकर, अपना सब कुछ समेटकर...

beats.visual: Wide cinematic shot of a rainy, neon-lit Bangalore railway station at dusk; a lone silhouette carrying a heavy suitcase walks toward a waiting train.
beats.vo_hi: मैं बेंगлुरु को हमेशा के लिए पीछे छोड़ आया।

beats.visual: He boards the train; through the window his still face slides past the platform lights; SONG Chal Chale swells.
The train pulls away into the rainy dark, tail lights receding; the city left behind; slow fade.
Palette shifts to brilliant warm golden-hour sunlight breaking over a quiet, serene, wide-open riverbank in Silchar, Assam; still water.
beats.vo_hi: वक्त का दरिया बहता रहा।

beats.visual: The mature 47-year-old protagonist (Actor 2) with white hair and soft white beard stands calmly by the shifting water, gentle and kind, at rest.
beats.vo_hi: आज सैंतालीस (47) की दहलीज पर, सिलचर की इस शांत हवा में...

beats.visual: He gently closes his eyes and takes a slow, unrestricted, deep breath; his face relaxes into quiet acceptance — peace, not a broad smile.
beats.vo_hi: मैंने अपनी परछाइयों से दोस्ती कर ली है।

beats.visual: Close on his calm peaceful eyes opening slowly to the golden river, soft lines of wisdom, deep internal quiet.
beats.vo_hi: अब कोई मलाल नहीं...

beats.visual: Long steady tracking shot of him by the wide golden river, small and at peace in the vast calm landscape.
beats.vo_hi: अब सिर्फ सुकून है।

beats.visual: The river and golden light hold, then fade slowly to black; SONG Boba Tunnel acoustic guitar swells to full for black-screen credits. Closing card: अब सिर्फ सुकून है।
